Test whether their obstruction ideal has empty projective support; for an unobstructed coordinate direction retain all second-order corrections and check the resulting actual family once.

This could identify a genuinely new full component after distinctness checks. If the obstructions vanish, an exact corrected family and orbit limits could instead yield MPS containment. No obstruction is tested on a truncated subset of the 350 equations.

The mixed extra class and non-tangent rank-three configurations remain separate.

negative_result_next_step: If the quadratic obstruction ideal has projective zeros and no exact corrected family emerges, report those retained directions and stop this finite job; do not infer componenthood from the nonintegrability of one chosen linear plane.
